summary.text: Brandon Strong is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 78, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Strong described himself as the executive director of Barry County Christian Schools and the owner of two local businesses.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Strong graduated from Waldron High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Trinity Bible College in 2006 and a graduate degree from South Dakota State University in 2011.
In the survey he said he has worked as a teacher, special education teacher, high school principal, coach and educational administrator.

Strong said he has led Barry County Christian Schools from a single campus serving 55 students to three campuses serving more than 250 students, and that he owns Green Light Driving Academy and Prosper Apparel.
Strong said he has served as chairman of the Barry County Chamber of Commerce and Economic Development Alliance and serves on the Barry County GOP Executive Committee.
He said he lives in Barry County with his wife, Samantha, and their five children.
He listed his campaign messages as strong families and communities; responsible leadership and fiscal stewardship; and growing opportunity through education, agriculture and small business.
Strong listed State Representative Jennifer Wortz and Barry County Commissioner Bob Teunessen as endorsers.
